about: DRAFT (Palermo money, task S1, 28 Oct 2026). The words of the 'Host Pass and looks' section and of the changed 'Is it free?' answer for Palermo Noir's landing page, in the template's own format. Nothing reads this file: the landing page does not change until George says yes. Launch order (design sections 5, 6 and 13): the Host Pass goes on sale first, alone, so 'section' and 'faq.item' are the LAUNCH version, which names only the Host Pass; 'whenTheyGoOnSale' holds what to add or swap when sets, single looks, coins and the supporter pack open. To publish the launch version: paste 'section' into palermo/page.json's sections, between 'love' and 'whats-new'; replace the 'Is it free?' item of palermo/faq.json with 'faq.item'; run 'node tools/build-pages.mjs palermo' and 'node tools/build-wiki.mjs'; link /terms/sale/ and /refunds/ from the section (the draft already does) and from the Palermo footer ('site.footer' in palermo/page.json), /terms/ and /privacy/. The site stays English only: the Greek of these words belongs in the game's own Greek localisation and the Greek store listing. The numbers are the money design's (Games/palermo docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-28-palermo-money-design.md sections 3, 5, 6, 7, 9, 11) and the catalog's: if either moves, change this file first.

section.title: Host Pass
section.intro: Palermo Noir is free: every role, every mode and every rule, for up to 14 players. If you love hosting, one optional thing makes your evenings nicer. Nothing you buy changes who wins.

items.label: once
items.title: Host Pass
items.text: For the friend whose TV and evening it is. No ads for anyone in your rooms, and later four TV themes, narrator voices, table records and every host item we add, at no extra charge.

items: Nothing changes a game. Every role, mode and rule stays free for everyone, with the pass or without it.
Nothing is random. You see what you buy, and its price in euros, before you pay. No mystery boxes, no timers, no “only today”.
Kept on your VHub account. Sign in on any phone or computer and your pass is back. Buyers are 16 or over.
Refund within 14 days. Ask and the money comes back; the pass goes. On the web, Paddle takes the payment, adds the VAT of your country and sends the receipt. Prices include VAT.

item.a: Yes, with every role in, for up to 14 players. Ads only show outside play, between games and never during one. If you host often, an optional Host Pass takes the ads away in your rooms: it changes how your evenings look and sound, never who wins. See Host Pass.

whenTheyGoOnSale.about: Add these when the looks open: the four sets and the Host Pass's four TV themes open all together once their art is done (George, 29 Oct), with single looks, coins and the supporter pack. Nothing here is for sale at the Host Pass launch.

section.title: Host Pass and looks
section.intro: Palermo Noir is free: every role, every mode and every rule, for up to 14 players. If you love your evenings, two optional things make them nicer. Nothing you buy changes who wins.

addFeatures.label: a set
addFeatures.title: Looks
addFeatures.text: Four looks around one place in Palermo: a portrait, a wax seal, a card back and a name plate. They belong to you, never to your role, and everyone at the table sees them.

addFeatures.label: supporter pack
addFeatures.title: Supporter pack
addFeatures.text: The Host Pass, all four sets and the Patron name plate, in one go.

addFeatures.label: coins
addFeatures.title: Single looks
addFeatures.text: Earn coins by playing and buy one look at a time. A finished game earns 30, a win 15 more, the first game of the day another 30, up to 300 a day. Coin packs, from €0.99, exist only in the phone apps.

steps: Nothing changes a game. Every role, mode and rule stays free. A look is drawn the same way, with the same timing and sound, whatever role you hold.
Nothing is random. You see what you buy, and its price in euros, before you pay. No mystery boxes, no timers, no “only today”.
Kept on your VHub account. Sign in on any phone or computer and your purchases are back. Buyers are 16 or over; players aged 13 to 15 earn and spend coins and buy nothing with money.
Refunds within 14 days. Ask and the money comes back; the item goes. On the web, Paddle takes the payment, adds the VAT of your country and sends the receipt. Prices include VAT.

faqItem.a: Yes, with every role in, for up to 14 players. Ads only show outside play, between games and never during one. Optional looks and a Host Pass are for sale if you want them: they change how your evenings look and sound, never who wins. See Host Pass and looks.
